info.name: Shadow Domain
info.description: The Shadow Domain Cleric subclass from World of Warcraft (Andrey Kuzinskiy).
info.author: Andrey Kuzinskiy (book), converted by Kaya Acarbay

description.p: Draw on the Debilitating Power of the Void

The Shadow Domain deals with the powers of shadow and the Void—a sinister mirror of the life-giving powers of the Light. Clerics who embrace these powers can wither their enemies’ flesh and debilitate their minds.

Your connection to this domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Shadow Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

tr.td: Crown of Madness, Dissonant Whispers, Mind Spike, Shadow Word: Pain

description.p: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of your Channel Divinity to take on a shadowy form that grants you the following benefits:
Shadow Stealth. While you are in an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.
Void Empowerment. When you cast a spell using a spell slot that deals Psychic or Necrotic damage, you can add 1d6 to one damage roll of the spell.
The form lasts for 1 minute, but it ends early if you dismiss it (no action required), if you have the Incapacitated condition, or if you deal Radiant damage with a spell.

description.p: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw, you can cause that creature to take 1d10 Necrotic damage. If you do, you regain Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

sheet.description: When a creature you can see within 30 feet fails a saving throw, it takes 1d10 Necrotic damage and you regain that many HP.

description.p: When you are hit by an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to disperse into shadowy energy. Until the end of your next turn, you have Resistance to all damage (including the damage from the triggering attack); you can’t take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction; and you have a Fly Speed of 40 feet. When the effect ends, you can spend up to half of your total Hit Point Dice, regaining Hit Points as if you had finished a Short Rest.
Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

description.p: While your Shadowform is active, whenever you roll 1d6 to add extra damage to a spell, one creature of your choice within 30 feet of you regains that many Hit Points.
